programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new midnight show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: Live: Get Up
programme.desc: ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

programme.title: Live: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: La mujer de Judas
programme.desc: Una apasionada periodista va en busca de "La Mujer de Judas" para saber más de esa leyenda. Ella se siente irresistiblemente atraída hacia esa mujer llamada Altagracia del Toro quien 23 años atrás fue acusada de asesinar a un sacerdote. La madre de Natalia que conoce muy bien los secretos que se esconden tras esa oscura leyenda, advierte a su hija que esa búsqueda podría poner en peligro su vida, pero ella no hace caso a la advertencia y viaja a ese lugar descubriendo que muchos misterios sin resolver saldrán a la luz.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Quererte así [NEW]
programme.desc: Una historia de amor que nace en medio de la avaricia de una familia, los destinos de Paulina y Rafael se cruzan y ellos caen víctimas de un amor profundo, el cual, está condenado al infortunio porque ellos provienen de dos clases sociales totalmente distintas, ella proviene de una prominente familia que posee uno de los consorcios hoteleros más grandes del país y por el contrario, él es un hombre humilde que no tiene nada que ofrecer a nivel monetario. Su amor puro y verdadero, deberá enfrentar a la familia de Paulina que está en contra y que desea que ella se case con un hombre afluente. Su destino es luchar por su amor y defender su felicidad por "Quererte Así".

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: UEPA: Un escenario para amar
programme.desc: Lourdes trabaja de bailarina y mesera para poder pagar la matrícula del internado donde su hermana estudia, pero lo mantiene escondido mientras le dice a todos que es una prestigiosa psicóloga.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Rutas de la vida
programme.desc: La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Cosas de la vida
programme.desc: Rocío Sanchez Azuara, la afamada y bella presentadora conduce "Cosas de la Vida", un programa de charla producido por TV Azteca, que trata temas y problemas que se presentan en la vida diaria de personas comunes. Cada capítulo de una hora relata historias reales y dramáticas, en donde sus protagonistas exponen sus casos conmovedores que llegan a tocar los corazones del público, incluyendo al de la conductora del programa y gracias a la ayuda de un equipo experto de profesionales y de la audiencia que está presente en el estudio, se tratan de resolver estos conflictos personales o familiares que los invitados están enfrentado.

Cada capítulo de una hora relata historias reales y dramáticas, en donde sus protagonistas exponen sus casos conmovedores que llegan a tocar los corazones del público, incluyendo al de la conductora del programa y gracias a la ayuda de un equipo experto de profesionales y de la audiencia que está presente en el estudio, se tratan de resolver estos conflictos personales o familiares que los invitados están enfrentado.

programme.title: La mujer de Judas
programme.desc: Una apasionada periodista va en busca de "La Mujer de Judas" para saber más de esa leyenda. Ella se siente irresistiblemente atraída hacia esa mujer llamada Altagracia del Toro quien 23 años atrás fue acusada de asesinar a un sacerdote. La madre de Natalia que conoce muy bien los secretos que se esconden tras esa oscura leyenda, advierte a su hija que esa búsqueda podría poner en peligro su vida, pero ella no hace caso a la advertencia y viaja a ese lugar descubriendo que muchos misterios sin resolver saldrán a la luz.

programme.title: Quererte así [NEW]
programme.desc: Una historia de amor que nace en medio de la avaricia de una familia, los destinos de Paulina y Rafael se cruzan y ellos caen víctimas de un amor profundo, el cual, está condenado al infortunio porque ellos provienen de dos clases sociales totalmente distintas, ella proviene de una prominente familia que posee uno de los consorcios hoteleros más grandes del país y por el contrario, él es un hombre humilde que no tiene nada que ofrecer a nivel monetario. Su amor puro y verdadero, deberá enfrentar a la familia de Paulina que está en contra y que desea que ella se case con un hombre afluente. Su destino es luchar por su amor y defender su felicidad por "Quererte Así".

programme.title: SportsCenter (Live)
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: Get Up (Live)
programme.desc: ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Hudson Square in Lower Manhattan, a modern media hub for ESPN and The Walt Disney Company's New York-based teams. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

programme.title: First Take (Live)
programme.desc: Stephen A. Smith hosts this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment.

programme.title: The Pat McAfee Show (Live)
programme.desc: Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor; he and his cast of characters unpack the day's top stories and interview the biggest names in sports.

programme.title: Big Day With Peter Schrager (Live)
programme.desc: Peter Schrager's daily show will feature rotating panelists focusing heavily on the NFL while also providing coverage of other major sports stories.

programme.title: NFL Live (Live)
programme.desc: Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The "NFL Live" crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL.

programme.title: SportsCenter (Live)
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms.

programme.title: Pardon the Interruption (Live)
programme.desc: The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day.

programme.title: Monday Night Countdown (Live)
programme.desc: Previewing the Monday Night Football matchup airing later on ESPN. Host Scott Van Pelt is joined by Ryan Clark, Jason Kelce, Marcus Spears, Adam Schefter and Michelle Beisner-Buck as they analyze every last morsel of information pertaining to Monday night's combatants, plus discuss the latest news that developed out of Sunday's action.

programme.title: Monday Night Kickoff (Live)
programme.desc: The legendary Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, and Lisa Salters preview the upcoming Monday Night Football action.

programme.title: NFL Football - Los Angeles Chargers at Baltimore Ravens (Live)
programme.desc: The Baltimore Ravens host the Los Angeles Chargers in NFL regular-season play at M&T Bank Stadium. Baltimore enters at 4-5 after four straight losses, but the Chargers have yet to win this season, arriving 0-8 after a 44-22 defeat to Houston.

programme.title: Monday Night Postgame (Live)
programme.desc: A recap of the Monday Night Football matchup with highlights, interviews and more.

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Live)
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly "1 Big Thing" commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in "Bad Beats." The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.title: NBA: Rockets at Heatᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: Amidst the humid Miami air, the league-leading Houston Rockets, with an 11-3 record, descend upon the Kaseya Center to face a surging Heat side that has won seven of its last ten. This opening encounter of a new series sees the visitors, boasting the NBA’s third-best field goal percentage, pitted against Miami’s formidable defense, which ranks third in blocks. Orchestrating the Rockets’ attack is Alperen Sengun, who averages 22.8 points and 9.5 rebounds, while the Heat counter with Giannis Antetokounmpo’s dominant 28.9 points and 12.5 boards per game. Houston’s aggressive play, leading the league in ejections, adds a volatile edge to this clash of conference rivals.

programme.title: NBA: Knicks at Raptorsᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: In Scotiabank Arena, the New York Knicks face the Toronto Raptors. Holding a 7-6 record and leading the series 1-0, the Knicks boast strong recent form, winning seven of ten. Jalen Brunson averages 26.7 points per game. The 5-8 Raptors, with three wins in ten, rely on Scottie Barnes (24.2 PPG, 2.1 SPG). Toronto leads the NBA in steals, while New York tops rebound rate. This Eastern Conference matchup sees the home side desperate to level the series.

programme.title: NBA: Wizards at Raptorsᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: The Washington Wizards head to Scotiabank Arena seeking to even the series, but the Toronto Raptors are defending home court with the league’s top-ranked steal unit leading a 1-0 aggregate advantage. Toronto’s 3-7 slide in their last ten contests belies a squad that leads the NBA in offensive rebounds and points in the paint, powered by Scottie Barnes’ nightly 23.5-point, 7.6-rebound output. Washington, sitting 4-9 and buried in the conference standings, counters with Anthony Davis’ dominant double-double machine (25.6 PPG, 10.5 RPG), though their 30.5% three-point shooting is a glaring weakness. This Eastern Conference tilt carries extra juice as a budding rivalry, with the Raptors’ swarming defense—first in steals and fouls—aiming to rattle a Wizards side that’s lost eight of ten.
